purpose: Reference behaviour on the Amendment 002 clarification corpus. Measured AFTER the expectations were frozen from revision 3 of the rule table; kept separate from the expectations so no prediction can be corrected once the measurement is in.
reading: `null` = the tool reported nothing, which for every tool except cognitive_complexity is indistinguishable from 0 (finding N3).

DeferPlainCall.detail: confirms default traversal: the deferred call's argument expression is counted by both sides

Inner.measured.detail: PMD reports it separately AND folds it into the enclosing method -- the double count is D27

javascript_and_typescript.note: constructs and clarifications behave identically in .js and .ts; both were measured and agreed.

logicalAssignAnd.detail: the `||` inside the right operand is what ArchLens counts; SonarJS scores `||` at zero

Inner.measured.detail: SonarJS reports the inner method separately and does NOT fold it -- the D10 alignment holds for discovery too

recursion_twice.detail: the only reference that also caps recursion at one per callable

comp_boolean_condition.detail: the reference counts only the `and`; the comprehension and its `if` clause score nothing

D22.title: Recursion counted per CALL SITE, not per callable
D22.evidence: Two self-call sites scored 2 and three scored 3 on both tools; `cognitive_complexity` scored 1 for all three, and SonarJS scored 0.
D22.archlens: capped at +1 per callable by owner decision; not changed

D23.title: gocognit does not detect receiver-qualified self-recursion
D23.evidence: `func (r receiverHolder) RecursiveMethod` calling `r.RecursiveMethod` scored 1 -- the `if` only.
D23.archlens: rule B recognizes the declared receiver identifier

D25.title: Parentheses SPLIT a same-operator run
D25.evidence: `a && (b && c)` scored 3 on both (1 for the `if` plus two sequences); PMD and SonarJS scored 2.
D25.archlens: parentheses are transparent -- one sequence. Owner-pinned.

D26.title: Two same-operator runs separated by a different operator are MERGED
D26.evidence: `a || b && c || d` scored 3 on both (1 for the `if` plus two sequences); gocognit scored 4.
D26.archlens: three runs -- the `&&` interrupts the `||` run. Owner-pinned.

D27.title: PMD both folds a named local class into the enclosing method and reports its method separately
D27.evidence: `discoveryLocalClassMethod` scored 2 while `measured` was also reported at 1 -- the same construct counted in two rows.
D27.archlens: B-NESTED: the enclosing method absorbs nothing; the inner method gets its own row only

observation: The two boolean-sequence divergences are the interesting pair: on `a && (b && c)` gocognit and the Python package split where PMD and SonarJS do not, and on `a || b && c || d` PMD and the Python package merge where gocognit does not. No two references agree on both. That is precisely why the owner pinned the seven expressions explicitly instead of leaving the definition to be inferred.
